meta.title: 1200 雅思核心词汇（占位示例集）
meta.note: 由 scripts/build-data.mjs 生成，请勿手工编辑；改词表请改源 CSV 后重新生成。

words.example: They had to abandon the plan because of the storm.
words.exampleCn: 由于暴风雨，他们不得不放弃这个计划。

words.en: existing as an idea rather than a physical thing
words.example: Beauty is an abstract concept.
words.exampleCn: 美是一个抽象的概念。

words.example: Her academic record is excellent.
words.exampleCn: 她的学业成绩非常优秀。

words.en: to provide room or make suitable
words.example: The hall can accommodate 500 people.
words.exampleCn: 这个大厅能容纳五百人。

words.example: Dust had accumulated on the shelves.
words.exampleCn: 架子上积满了灰尘。

words.example: Children acquire language remarkably fast.
words.exampleCn: 儿童习得语言的速度快得惊人。

words.en: enough in amount or good enough in quality
words.example: The lighting here is not adequate for reading.
words.exampleCn: 这里的光线不够，不适宜阅读。

words.example: Many experts advocate a shorter working week.
words.exampleCn: 许多专家主张缩短每周工作时间。

words.example: The council will allocate extra funds to schools.
words.exampleCn: 议会将向学校额外拨款。

words.en: having more than one possible meaning
words.example: His reply was deliberately ambiguous.
words.exampleCn: 他的回答故意含糊不清。

words.example: We anticipate a rise in demand next year.
words.exampleCn: 我们预计明年的需求会上升。

words.en: easy to see or understand; seeming
words.example: It soon became apparent that no one was in charge.
words.exampleCn: 很快就明显看出没有人负责。

words.en: a way of dealing with something
words.example: We need a fresh approach to this problem.
words.exampleCn: 我们需要用新方法来处理这个问题。

words.en: to judge the quality or value of something
words.example: Teachers assess students' progress each term.
words.exampleCn: 老师每学期评估学生的进步情况。

words.en: to accept as true without proof
words.example: Do not assume that everyone agrees with you.
words.exampleCn: 不要以为每个人都同意你的看法。

words.example: She attained her goal after years of effort.
words.exampleCn: 经过多年的努力，她达到了目标。

words.example: Regular exercise is beneficial to health.
words.exampleCn: 经常锻炼对健康有益。

words.example: The report gives a comprehensive review of the market.
words.exampleCn: 这份报告对市场做了全面回顾。

words.example: He missed the train and consequently arrived late.
words.exampleCn: 他没赶上火车，因此迟到了。

words.en: to protect from harm or waste
words.example: We should conserve water in dry seasons.
words.exampleCn: 旱季我们应该节约用水。

words.example: The new policy is highly controversial.
words.exampleCn: 新政策引起了很大争议。

words.example: Timing is crucial in this experiment.
words.exampleCn: 在这个实验中，时机至关重要。

words.en: to become smaller or weaker; to refuse
words.example: Sales declined sharply last quarter.
words.exampleCn: 上季度销售额急剧下降。

words.example: The study demonstrates a clear link between diet and mood.
words.exampleCn: 这项研究证明了饮食与情绪之间有明确联系。

words.en: to obtain or come from a source
words.example: Many English words derive from Latin.
words.exampleCn: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语。

words.en: to recognize the difference between things
words.example: Babies can distinguish their mother's voice.
words.exampleCn: 婴儿能分辨出母亲的声音。

words.example: The city has a diverse population.
words.exampleCn: 这座城市的人口构成十分多元。

words.en: to have control or be the most important
words.example: A few firms dominate the industry.
words.exampleCn: 少数几家公司主导着这个行业。

words.example: Public transport here is cheap and efficient.
words.exampleCn: 这里的公共交通既便宜又高效。

words.example: New evidence has emerged in the case.
words.exampleCn: 该案出现了新证据。
